decisions.reason: The same-message MODIFY already fully records the selected LED part number, model, package, and RGBW format for the LED board; no additional or corrected Event is needed.
Selecting a specific LCSC-listed LED does not change the existing general sourceability or cost-control policy.
The LED BOM entry does not change the required order assistance, assembly-setting review, or setup-fee review.

The exact SK6812MINI-E selection may inform voltage and level-shifter requirements, but the client had separately reopened the need for a shifter at message 425, and message 432 does not explicitly resolve that electrical decision. The existing same-message electrical MODIFY may therefore over-infer the impact.
The selected LED component does not change whether KiCad footprints and project resources are portable.
The numerical alias match is incidental; the LED package selection does not affect I2C pull-ups, series resistors, speed, or cable-length constraints.
The exact LED BOM part does not necessarily change the sensor-rail voltage, GPIO control, converter, or independently controlled sensor-power behavior.
The LED component selection has no effect on the selected ESP32-S3 module model or breakout requirement.
The LED BOM entry does not alter the AXP2101 battery, USB, VMID/VSYS, or DCDC1 power-path requirements.
Choosing the exact LED model and package does not change the established LED cutoff behavior, control GPIO, standby-current target, or separate control architecture.
The LED part-number decision does not modify any ESP32-S3 GPIO assignment or compatibility constraint.
The LED component selection does not affect the sensor-board module inventory, connector types, connector pinouts, or connector count.
